name: Case study stat cards (content)
purpose: Gives a content-library case study its at-a-glance facts: one headline number plus the solutions and content topics the customer used.
description: Three hairline-bordered cards in a row (one column at 991 and below) on the content ("yellow") legacy theme: a dotted-texture card with a large yellow Source Serif stat and its label, a "Solutions" card with bordered chips, and a "Topics used" card with chips that optionally carry a check-circle icon. The stat number and solutions list rise in on scroll.
